resources.string: Keeps this device linked to your family / workspace dashboard. Silent is fine — do not block.
Android stops Zenvora after a few minutes if this notification is blocked. Turn it back on (silent is fine).
Connected to your family / workspace dashboard
Screen or camera is sharing with your dashboard
Enter the 6-digit Pair Token and Pair User ID from your Zenvora dashboard (parent / admin).
Could not verify those codes. Check Settings on the website and try again.
Enable permissions to protect this device
Like other parental-control apps, Zenvora needs these so a parent or admin can keep this phone safe and connected.
Allow screen sharing so your dashboard can see this display.
Allow camera access so your dashboard can use this camera.
Allow microphone access so your dashboard can hear this device.
Allow file access so your dashboard can browse photos and downloads.
Zenvora uses Accessibility for parental / family safety: it can read web addresses from browsers you open so browsing activity can appear on the parent dashboard. It does not click or type for you.
Device administrator for parental / family safety (lock policies). Same class of permission used by parental-control apps. You can revoke anytime in Settings → Security → Device admin apps.
